# Document this comparator as a boolean ordering predicate

The adapter comparator answers whether message A belongs above message B. getTextComparator converts the collator result to a boolean with < 0; descending order swaps arguments before calling the predicate. This is not the negative/zero/positive callback contract of Array.sort. Preserve the return type and argument-order meaning in helpers and JSDoc. Accepted collator construction no longer contains the original sensitivity: base option. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Panorama comparator syntax.
